### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues remain for the change to include thinking tokens in Vertex AI completion-token usage. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Updates Vertex AI chat completion usage to include thinking tokens as output tokens, aligning it with the Google AI connector change in #14671. **Changes:** - Calculates completion tokens as candidate tokens plus thinking tokens. - Adds a regression test verifying that 10 candidate tokens and 40 thinking tokens produce 50 completion tokens. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​test_vertex_ai_chat_completion.py` | Adds coverage for usage that includes thinking tokens. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​google/​vertex_ai/​services/​vertex_ai_chat_completion.py` | Includes thinking tokens in completion-token metadata. |
Review effort: Balanced

comments.body: Closing in favor of #14716, which carries the same Vertex AI thinking-token usage fix for chat completion and also covers the text completion path. Sorry for the duplicate.
